note: Deterministic concept-distribution markers for the LoRA/QLoRA fixture. A section 'carries' a concept when every pattern group in `all` matches somewhere in that section. Owner = the section designated by argumentUnits to explain it fully. Markers locate candidates; whether a hit is a harmful full re-explanation or a one-sentence back-reference is decided by reading.
